page.overview:
What is Think for Yourself?

Think for Yourself is a Beatles song written by George Harrison. It was included on the Rubber Soul album. The Lyrics were saturated with Negative words such as "lies", "ruins" and "misery". Paul McCartney applied a fuzzbox to his bass, creating a fuzz bass effect. In a departure from all precedent, they also used two bass parts on the track; one fuzz and the other regular. John Lennon played organ on this song instead of the rhythm guitar which he usually played. The song is in the key of G major. This song is in The Beatles: Rock Band Rubber Soul DLC.

The ruins of the life that you have in mind

Try thinking more if just for your own sake

^Lyrics are from [https://genius.com/ Genius]
